name: PROD: Change of Provider Is Silently Ignored (Flag Off)
description: Proves that with FeatureFlags.ShortCourseChangeOfProvider OFF (the shipped, prod-like state), a second provider's POST for a learner already known to a different provider is silently ignored: CreateDraftShortCourseCommandHandler returns null for that item, no new ShortCourseLearning/Episode is created, and the API still returns a 2xx response. Run this story only with ShortCourseChangeOfProvider disabled. Provider A POSTs ZSC00001 (unapproved). Provider B then POSTs the same course code for the same learner. Expect: 200/204 response, exactly 1 episode total (Provider A's), no episode for Provider B's UKPRN.

steps.name: Provider B (10005078) POSTs the same course for the same learner

assertions.name: Exactly 1 ShortCourseEpisode row in Learning DB (Provider A only)
No episode exists for Provider B in Learning DB
Exactly 1 ShortCourseEpisode row in Earnings DB (Provider A only)
